title: Making up missed prayers (qada’)
intro: If we miss a prayer, it is our duty to make it up.

learn.html: Every Muslim must pray regularly and on time. But if we miss one or more prayers, it is our duty to make them up (qada’).

items.label: Waqtiyyah – the prayer whose time is now

items: Only the fard of the five daily prayers, and the witr
The sunnahs are not made up – except the sunnah of Fajr, when we make up Fajr on the same day after sunrise
Missed prayers are made up in the same order as we should have prayed them

learn.title: The niyyah
learn.html: We make the niyyah as for a normal prayer, but instead of adaa’an (on time) we say qadaa’an (making up) – for example: …fardil-fajri qadaa’an mustaqbilal-qiblah…

items: Fewer than six missed prayers: first the missed prayers, then the prayer of the time
Six or more missed prayers: first the prayer of the time, then the missed ones
We don’t need to keep this order if the time of the current prayer is running out, if there are six or more missed prayers, or if we forgot we had missed prayers

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: Best of all is to pray every prayer on time – then there is nothing to make up!

pairs: The prayer whose time is now

practice.title: Do we make it up?
practice.prompt: If we missed it, do we make it up?

options: The prayer whose time is now

questions.q: In what order do we make up missed prayers?
options: The same order we should have prayed them

questions.q: Which word do we say in the niyyah for a missed prayer?
We missed 2 prayers. What do we pray first?
options: The missed prayers, then the prayer of the time
The prayer of the time, then the missed ones
Only the prayer of the time

questions.q: Which sunnah can be made up?
options: The sunnah of Fajr, on the same day

practice.title: Do your homework
prompts: 📋 Make two tables: “I PRAYED” and “I STILL NEED TO PRAY”, with the days of the week and the five prayers.
✅ Each time you pray, mark it in “I PRAYED”. Mark a minus in the other table for a missed prayer – and when you make it up, turn the minus into a plus with another colour.
💬 What is a fa’itah and what is a waqtiyyah?
